roam.motion.reduce.zh-Hans: 在此应用中减少动态效果

roam.motion.hint.en: This device-only preference reduces supported in-app animations. It does not change iOS settings.
roam.motion.hint.zh-Hans: 仅保存在这台设备，减少应用内已支持的动画；不会修改 iOS 设置。

roam.motion.system.en: iOS Reduce Motion is on. It remains in effect when this switch is off.
roam.motion.system.zh-Hans: iOS 已开启“减少动态效果”；关闭此开关后仍会遵循系统设置。

roam.motion.followsSystem.zh-Hans: 正在遵循 iOS 动态效果设置

native_preference.system_preference: Read-only; system true OR local true

required_follow_through: Register the new Core source in the app target and the UI test in its existing target through the central project owner.
Merge six EN/zh-Hans entries into the existing catalog.
Run ReducedMotionPreferenceTests, the existing RoamRouteReplayTests and RoamReducedMotionFlowTests, then an unsigned Apple app build.
Verify actual iOS Reduce Motion on/off, local preference persistence, VoiceOver and existing animation consumers on a device; the DEBUG override does not prove real system behavior.
